summary: Flawless chromatic dispersion. A densely packed, ultra-soft brush engineered specifically for liquid and cream architectures.
description: Aesthetic surfacing tool. Unlike porous animal hair which absorbs and wastes product, these advanced Taklon bristles are totally hydrophobic, ensuring 100% of the pigment is transferred and buffed seamlessly into the skin.
technical_overview: Offered at $35.0 for 1 Unit, this KoColor BRUSHES is expertly formulated with Vegan Taklon Bristles and a Solid Wood Core. It delivers a high-fidelity Obsidian Handle color profile (`#000000`) and leverages hydrophobic filament technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Stipple (tap) the product onto the face, then use rapid circular motions to buff and blur the edges.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Wash weekly with a designated lipid-restoring cleanser; dish soap will degrade the synthetic filaments and cause them to snap.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Each individual bristle is laser-tapered at the microscopic level to eliminate streak marks in high-coverage foundations.
